judged_text: handleNewBooking builds evt.destinationCalendar as null when neither the event type nor the organizer has a destination calendar, then gates the member-calendar merge on evt.destinationCalendar?.push, which no-ops on null. A collective booking whose organizer has no destination calendar silently drops every team member's destination calendar collected in teamDestinationCalendars, so members' calendars never receive the event — defeating the PR's own objective for exactly this organizer shape.

adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking, evt.destinationCalendar is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for collective team events, the code relies on `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. Optional chaining means this is a no-op when destinationCalendar is null, so the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are silently dropped in exactly that organizer shape. This is directly verifiable from the diff and breaks the intended behavior of including team members’ destination calendars.
